description: Source code for USB EHCI driver for oxnas platform, including initialization, reset, clock management, and USB mode setting functions.

methods.name: start_oxnas_usb_ehci
methods.description: Initializes and configures the USB EHCI hardware, including clock setup and reset sequences.

methods.name: ehci_hcd_init
methods.description: Initializes the EHCI host controller, sets up base addresses and controller pointers.

methods.name: ehci_hcd_stop
methods.description: Stops the EHCI host controller and disables its clock.

methods.name: ehci_set_usbmode
methods.description: Configures the USB mode and tuning parameters for the EHCI controller.
